senses.definition: (transitive, intransitive) To take for granted; to conclude, with less than absolute supporting data; to believe.
examples: I suppose we all agree that this is the best solution.
I won't be back before midday, I don't suppose.
I don't suppose you could lend me a euro, could you?
We're a place setting short, there'll be four of us - always supposing your sis really comes.
Mum, can go to the park yet? ~ Suppose you did your homework first.

quotes.text: ‘No,’ said Luke, grinning at her. ‘You're not dull enough! […] What about the kid's clothes? I don't suppose they were anything to write home about, but didn't you keep anything? A bootee or a bit of embroidery or anything at all?’
quotes.reference: 1963, Margery Allingham, chapter 15, in The China Governess: A Mystery, London: Chatto & Windus, →OCLC:

examples: Suppose that A implies B and B implies C. Then A implies C.

quotes.text: Of all the queer collections of humans outside of a crazy asylum, it seemed to me this sanitarium was the cup winner. […] When you're well enough off so's you don't have to fret about anything but your heft or your diseases you begin to get queer, I suppose.

quotes.text: Just what is supposed to be wrong with the pursuit of fame is not always made clear. Plato disapproved of competition for praise on the grounds that it would tempt the great to bend to the will of the crowd. It is hard to argue with that, and social degradation remains a fear.

quotes.text: How easy is a bush supposed a bear!

senses.definition: (transitive) To require to exist or to be true; to imply by the laws of thought or of nature.

quotes.text: One falsehood always supposes another, and renders all you can say suspected.

senses.definition: (transitive, obsolete) To put by fraud in the place of another; to substitute fraudulently.

quotes.text: A Water-monster, called the Nickard, does enter by night the chamber, where a woman is brought to bed, and stealeth when they are all sleeping, the new-born child and supposeth another in its place, which child growing up is like a monster and commonly dumb.
